name: expertum
description: Four slash commands — /expertum:review, /expertum:research, /expertum:interview, and /expertum:conduct — that fan a task out to read-only expert sub-agents. Review and research collect findings; interview walks the user through adaptive questionnaires to turn a vague idea into a pinned brief; conduct adds an autonomous plan->implement->expert-review loop in which the main agent does the coding. Commands run inside the stock main agent (no default-agent override): with an argument they act on the given instructions, without one they act on the preceding conversation. Analysts write one Markdown report each into a per-run .expertum/<timestamp>--<name>/ folder via a bundled zero-dependency MCP server.
